title: The OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial inference at planetary scale
summary: OlmoEarth is a geospatial inference platform by AI2 that enables planetary-scale analysis by combining satellite imagery with language models, offering a scalable infrastructure for environmental and social applications.
highlights: OlmoEarth enables geospatial inference at planetary scale.
The platform integrates satellite data with language models for broad applications.
It provides scalable infrastructure for environmental and social analysis.
